calculation.description: Ranks assets for short-horizon relative reversal after normalizing the three-day deviation from the same-day cross-sectional median by trailing 15-session realized volatility. All inputs are lagged to the completed decision-date close.

validation.regime_notes: Passed the benchmark-wide absolute IC and ICIR gates at the 10-session horizon on 307 dates from the available 2025-2027 history. The 5-session result also passed (IC 0.030607, ICIR 0.114880), while the 1-session result was negative (IC -0.016608, ICIR -0.062539). The factor has low effective coverage because the 15-session volatility window and cross-asset alignment begin in 2025; uncertainty should be interpreted conservatively for the 15-instrument universe.
